question: What is the primary function of the skin's acid mantle?

options.C: Producing vitamin D through sun exposure
options.D: Enhancing the absorption of topical cosmetics

explanation: The slightly acidic nature of the skin surface creates an unfavorable environment for pathogenic microorganisms to grow. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T9#GNS213_U5_T9_h1)

question: Why is maintaining skin integrity considered a core nursing responsibility?

options.A: It guarantees faster recovery from surgical procedures
options.B: It eliminates the need for systemic antibiotic therapy
options.C: It prevents external pathogens from entering the body
options.D: It reduces overall hospital admission rates permanently

explanation: An intact skin barrier stops microorganisms and environmental toxins from penetrating deep tissues and causing systemic infections. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T9#GNS213_U5_T9_h1)

question: The primary purpose of using lukewarm water for bathing is to prevent what?
explanation: Hot water dissolves and removes protective skin lipids, leaving the skin dry and susceptible to irritation. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T9#GNS213_U5_T9_h2)

question: When is the best time to apply a moisturizing emollient to the skin?

options.A: Immediately after bathing while skin is damp
options.C: Only when the skin feels visibly scaly
options.D: Right before taking a hot shower

explanation: Applying emollients on damp skin locks in the remaining water molecules, enhancing hydration of the stratum corneum. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T9#GNS213_U5_T9_h2)

question: Which vitamin acts as a primary antioxidant and supports collagen production?
explanation: Vitamin C is necessary for hydroxylation of proline and lysine in collagen synthesis, keeping dermal tissues strong. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T9#GNS213_U5_T9_h3)

question: How does severe protein deficiency directly affect the skin?

options.A: It causes immediate overproduction of natural skin oils
options.B: It triggers rapid darkening of the dermal layers
options.C: It permanently closes all eccrine sweat glands
options.D: It impairs cellular repair and delays wound healing

explanation: Proteins supply the amino acids required to build new skin cells and repair damaged dermal matrices. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T9#GNS213_U5_T9_h3)

question: What is the main purpose of wearing protective gloves when handling harsh chemicals?
explanation: Gloves create a physical barrier that stops strong chemicals from stripping lipids and damaging the epidermal layer. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T9#GNS213_U5_T9_h4)

question: Which complication is most commonly associated with chronic, unprotected exposure to UV radiation?
explanation: UV radiation causes cellular DNA mutations and breaks down collagen fibers, leading to wrinkles and skin cancers. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T9#GNS213_U5_T9_h4)

question: How often should an immobile bedridden patient typically be repositioned?
explanation: Repositioning every two hours relieves sustained pressure on capillaries, allowing blood flow to nourish vulnerable tissues. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T9#GNS213_U5_T9_h5)

question: Why is a draw sheet used when moving a patient in bed?

options.A: To warm up the patient during cold weather
options.B: To keep the bottom mattress completely dry
options.C: To minimize skin friction and shear forces
options.D: To measure the exact weight of the patient

explanation: Lifting the patient with a draw sheet rather than dragging them across the bed sheet prevents friction damage to the epidermis. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T9#GNS213_U5_T9_h5)

question: In the ABCDE guide for evaluating skin lesions, what does the letter 'A' stand for?
explanation: Asymmetry means one half of the mole does not match the other half, which is a warning sign for melanoma. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T9#GNS213_U5_T9_h6)

question: Why is secondary prevention through regular self-examinations important for skin health?

options.A: It replaces the need for professional clinical assessments
options.B: It catches abnormalities early when treatment is most effective
options.C: It completely stops new moles from forming on the skin
options.D: It prevents environmental UV radiation from damaging cells

explanation: Early detection of cancerous or precancerous skin lesions significantly improves patient survival and treatment outcomes. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T9#GNS213_U5_T9_h6)
